info.title: AEGIS Early-Warning System API
info.description: Community early-warning system alert delivery engine and manual incident management API for Nigerian communities.

identifier.description: Login identifier: Nigerian phone number (+234... / 080...) OR registered email address

phone.description: Nigerian phone number in E.164 (+234...) or local format (080...)

route.description: Destination route for user role dashboard

refreshToken.description: Rotating refresh token (can also be provided automatically via HttpOnly cookie)

email.description: Email address for login & credentials dispatch

role.description: User access role: RESIDENT, SECURITY, or ADMIN

preferredLanguage.description: Preferred alert language: ENGLISH, HAUSA, IGBO, YORUBA, PIDGIN

areaDescription.example: Angwan Rimi Close, Near Central Mosque
areaDescription.description: Area description, street name, or local landmark

alertsEnabled.description: Whether emergency alert notifications are active (defaults to true)

password.description: Custom password. If omitted, a secure random password will be auto-generated and emailed

email.description: Email address for login & credentials dispatch

role.description: User access role: RESIDENT, SECURITY, or ADMIN

preferredLanguage.description: Preferred alert language: ENGLISH, HAUSA, IGBO, YORUBA, PIDGIN

areaDescription.example: Angwan Rimi Close, Near Central Mosque
areaDescription.description: Area description, street name, or local landmark

alertsEnabled.description: Whether emergency alert notifications are active (defaults to true)

password.description: Custom password. If omitted, a secure random password will be auto-generated and emailed

isActive.description: Active status for soft deactivation / reactivation

residents.description: List of resident records to onboard

type.description: Type of security or emergency incident

severity.description: Severity level: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL

description.example: Multiple individuals spotted attempting to breach northern community perimeter gate.

latitude.description: Incident latitude coordinate (derived from zone if omitted)

longitude.description: Incident longitude coordinate (derived from zone if omitted)

alertRadiusMeters.description: Alert blast radius in meters (snapshotted at creation; default: 2000m)

acknowledgeDuplicates.description: Explicit acknowledgment if a duplicate incident was detected within 500m in the last 30m

description.example: Perimeter movement reported near northern gate.

confirmLargeBlast.description: Explicit confirmation if eligible blast count exceeds safety limit (MAX_RECIPIENTS_PER_INCIDENT)

overrideSelfVerify.description: Administrator override to bypass Four-Eyes principle if operating with a single officer

reason.example: False alarm. Community patrol verified normal activity with no perimeter threat.
reason.description: Mandatory reason for dismissal (min 5, max 500 characters)

sendAllClear.description: Whether to dispatch an ALL_CLEAR notification broadcast to previous alert recipients

notes.example: Perimeter secured by community joint patrol team. Danger has passed.

areaName.description: Human-readable community landmark or zone name (no raw GPS coordinates allowed)

allowUnreviewed.description: Permit rendering templates pending native linguistic review

preserveDiacritics.description: Preserve Hausa hooked letters (UCS-2) or transliterate to ASCII (GSM-7)

message_id.description: Unique provider message identifier returned during dispatch

status.description: Delivery status reported by telecom carrier or gateway

phone.description: Destination phone number snapshot in E.164 format

reason.description: Failure or rejection reason if message could not be delivered
reason.example: Carrier DND active on subscriber number

delivered_at.description: Timestamp when delivery was confirmed by carrier

hasUnreviewedTemplates.description: Flag if templates need native review in production

oldestPendingAgeMinutes.description: Age of oldest pending incident in minutes

alertingCount.description: Incidents currently in alert fan-out process

peopleAtRiskCount.description: Estimated people within active incident blast zones

alertsEnabled.description: Whether resident has SMS alerts enabled

recentCommunityAlerts.description: Recent verified public alerts in community
